subject.title: [Feature Request] skill_workshop: add delete action to remove applied proposals

question: Should applied create and update proposals receive different reversible cleanup behavior, or should OpenClaw expose a privileged permanent purge?
rationale: Create proposals install new content, while update proposals replace pre-existing content and record rollback state; one unconditional directory-delete rule cannot safely serve both.

options.title: Kind-aware reversible cleanup
options.body: Uninstall create outputs and restore or archive update outputs while retaining provenance, checking content drift, and supporting recovery.

options.title: Privileged permanent purge
options.body: Expose a separately named destructive purge with explicit approval, backup, and warnings for modified or pre-existing content.

options.title: Metadata-only cleanup
options.body: Archive or hide applied proposal records while leaving live skills and rollback state untouched.

recommendation.title: Kind-aware reversible cleanup
recommendation.body: Uninstall create outputs and restore or archive update outputs while retaining provenance, checking content drift, and supporting recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal covers the proposal store, persisted lifecycle, apply behavior, and its safety invariants.
